name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: The order with the Tart's price is exactly $4 more than Ben.
The order with the Scone has a higher price than the order with Toffee syrup.
Ben's price is between the order in the Jade mug and the order with Vanilla syrup.
The order with the Croissant has a higher price than Ava.
The order in the Ivory mug's price is immediately below Felix.
The order in the Crimson mug's price is higher than both the order with the Croissant and the order with Pumpkin syrup.
The order in the Ivory mug's price is exactly $4 more than the order with Almond syrup.
